translation.name: Ilagano lya Katali, Ilagano Linyale kwa Wanhu Weng’ha

content: Kulawila Mamle, Abulahamu nakenula majendo kulutila Negebu, nakadita luga lwake hagati ha Kadeshi na Shuli, hamba nakaluta kikala ako Gelali kwa mhela uchefu.
Loyawele ako, Abulahamu nakalonga kota mchewake Sala ka lumbulye. Lelo mndewa Abimeleki wa Gelali nakamhesa Sala.
Ila Nguluwi nakamuyila Abimeleki nechilo loyali yolota, nakamlonjela, “Hegwe kobagama kwa mbuli ya mdala youmholile, kwa vila kana mlume wake.”
Abimeleki nayang'hali wasa na Sala, nakedichila, “Mkulu, kowakopola wanhu wohawawele na nongwa?
Heye Abulahamu ndo yalonjile kota ayu mdala ka lumbulye. Kahi na heye Sala nakalonga kota Abulahamu kalumbu wa heye. Heni ndita vyonditile kwa nhumbula igoloche ndahela nongwa.”
Nguluwi nakamlonjela koyali yolota, “Goya. Ndivizela kota kudita ahyo kwa nhumbula igoloche, na heni ndo ndikulemeze kudita gehile ago, ndo mina sikukundiza umdolize ayo mdala.
Lelo umhiluse ayo mdala kwa mlume wa heye. Abulahamu ndo mloli wa heni, na heye kokulandila nagwe kowa mkomu. Ila wone humhiluse, uvizele ng'hatu kota hegwe kobagama hamwe na wanhu wa hegwe weng'ha.”
Abimeleki nakalilimka lufuku, nakawachema vitumagwa wa heye weng'ha na kuwalonjela mbuli nazoyaziwene koyali yolota, na hewo nawadumba ng'hatu.

Baho, Abimeleki nakamchema Abulahamu, na kumuuza, “Nakutuditila choni? Lekachoni nakunyambuza heni kudita gehile na sambi Nguluwi kangugana kungaza heni na undewa wa heni? Kunditila mbuli zohaziganigwa kuditigwa.”
Abimeleki nakalutilila kumuuza Abulahamu, “Chinhu chachi chikuditile kudita hino?”
Abulahamu nakamwidichila, “Nandita hino kwa vila nandijesa kota kuduhu munhu ne yumwe yalingumdumba Nguluwi honhu hano, na kota mwahang'hopole leka mumhole mchewangu.
Kuleka kwa ago, ndangukomya, heye ka lumbulyangu, mhaza wa heye na mhaza wa heni ndo yumwe, ila hatihanzile mamo, ndo mina kawa mchewangu.
Mhela Nguluwi loyanditile ndiileche ng'handa ya mhaza wa heni na kuluta kuujenzi, nandimlonjela mchewangu, ‘Honeche hotuluta, dedede ulajile igano kwa heni kwa kulonga kota heni nda lumbulyo.’ ”
Abimeleki nakamhilusila Abulahamu mchewake Sala, nakamha na ming'holo na misenga na vitumagwa walume na wadala.
Abimeleki nakamlonjela Abulahamu, “Ulole, isi ayi yeng'ha ya heni. Lelo uhagule heng'ha hala uhaganile, wikale.”
Hamba nakamlonjela Sala, “Ulole, heni ndimha mng'holozo migwala maelufu menji leka kuwalajila wawele hamwe na hegwe kota kwahela nongwa, nakutawizwa kota kwahela nongwa”
Hamba Abulahamu nakamlanda Nguluwi, na heye kamlohola Abimeleki na mchewake na vitumagwa wa heye mdala, mbaka nawaweza kuponda kahi wana.
Aho mwaluko Mkulu Nguluwi nayali yawalemeze wadala weng'ha wa ng'handa ya Abimeleki kuponda wana kwa mbuli ya Sala mchewake Abulahamu.
